sentences.text: There are three levels of urgent call.
Mayday means grave and imminent danger to life or the vessel, such as sinking, fire or a man overboard.
Pan-pan means an urgent situation without immediate danger to life, like a disabled engine drifting offshore.
Securité is a safety message, such as a navigation hazard.

A Mayday is sent on VHF channel sixteen, following the script on screen: Mayday three times, your boat’s name three times, your position, the problem, the help you need, the number aboard and a description of the boat.
Then release the button and listen.
